Docs/Troubleshooting

Troubleshooting

Resolve source, asset, controller and replay mismatches before changing the benchmark configuration.

Missing modules, registration or assets

There is no task package after cloning the public repository

The current official repository contains the README, Apache 2.0 license and repository metadata. The executable module examples require the asset-complete research source; there is no published DexArena package or asset download command to infer from these docs. Check release status.

The environment ID is not registered

Run from the prepared research checkout and import task before direct Gym creation. Check the exact ID in task/config/collection_targets.py; aliases and retired curricula are not formal targets.

A mesh or native kitchen cannot be loaded

Verify project robot/object assets and the corresponding RoboCasa scene assets against the research revision. The paper, website images and preview videos are not installable simulator assets.

Action and observation mismatches

The action width is correct but the robot moves incorrectly

Check semantic joint order, radians, inverse normalization and absolute/relative conversion. pd_joint_pos expects absolute targets. Sharpa has 29 targets for one arm and 58 for a dual-arm configuration; other hands have their own spaces.

A model rejects state or image inputs

Compare training and evaluation camera keys, resolutions, crops, channel ordering, temporal history and normalization. Task state widths vary. The native-scene factory's fixed camera rig can differ from ordinary task defaults.

The scene factory rejects an override

Use one CPU environment, the registered robot/horizon/controller and 256 × 256 policy cameras. Check the conflicting value against registered_task_settings; do not bypass validation to force an incompatible run.

Rendering and replay failures

CPU physics still fails during rendering

CPU physics and rendering are separate. The scene factory requires a render backend. Verify the local ManiSkill/SAPIEN renderer and graphics-driver setup, then try the smallest scene preview before loading a large model.

A restored frame matches but the trajectory diverges

Compare source fingerprints, reset seed, environment state, controller and background manifest. The solver's transient contact cache is not restored with rigid state. Use both frame-restoration validation and action replay rather than treating one as proof of the other.

A sequence works only when reset between stages

Check stage instructions, cached policy state and pending action chunks at transitions. The long-horizon protocol preserves simulator state after the initial reset; intermediate resets change the evaluation.

Teleoperation bridge conflicts

For the Sharpa bridge, inspect the configured ports before starting another process:

ss -ltnp '( sport = :2044 or sport = :6668 )'

Reuse the correct listener or close its owning terminal cleanly. If you change a bridge endpoint, update its paired endpoint as well. Wuji and XHand require their own profile checks.

For any failed evaluation, retain the complete command, source revision, environment settings, seed, background manifest and error log. Reproduce it with the smallest relevant example from Quick evaluation or Scene evaluation before scaling back up.
